scope: Acceptance inputs for the real common parser and operand resolver; not executed by the text/package checker
discovery: common Expression tree grouping followed by its separate application adapter; builtin implementation and mode metadata are not supplied
left_consumption: declaration identifier consumed as DATA, not a lookup of an existing value
current_named_contract: ALL arguments of :: are DATA. One right Structure is one external actual; the common namespace mechanism reads its immediate fields, or referenced DATA fields, when the receiver requires a declaration list. This is not a special :: opening, external operand expansion, CODE W/E, a call or recursive flattening. Ready signature profiles are consumed without reflection of service fields.

cases.declaration_meaning: No additional multi-right-argument signature semantics is defined by this package

One written DATA-template actual. Common namespace consumption supplies its immediate fields A and B as the declaration list required by the receiver contract. Field validity remains ordinary signature admission; the outer operand vector is unchanged.

P0 preserves both written containers. Common list consumption reads one immediate nested Structure field from the outer description. It does not recursively flatten that inner field or alter outer operand arity; the nested field retains its ordinary declaration/model contract.

Existing generated signature construction: the common namespace mechanism follows the one DATA reference and reads the target description's immediate declaration list under the receiving contract, without calling the Structure or executing formal initializers.

requirements: The tree grouper and application adapter preserve the stated current-level RHS boundaries with this scalar declaration identifier
No automatic equivalence between a bare chain and a grouped Structure

CODE/Expression graph classification uses ordinary named Structure actual-parent equality for calls, foreign-parent named Structures and anonymous Structures for groups; VALUE/TYPE/DATA boundaries do not become CODE automatically
The :: expression opens no Frame and its left name creates no end target

Common namespace/field-sequence consumption reads immediate fields of a Structure or referenced DATA when the receiving contract requires a declaration list; :: uses this same mechanism, separate from external actual boundaries and without recursive flattening
A ready positional signature profile is consumed as a profile, not reflected into service-field declarations
DATA or CODE determines how selected elements are consumed; the receiver contract chooses a list or a whole value, so CODE W/E is not automatically extended to DATA
Whole TYPE/model/value profiles, nested declarations and structured return descriptions preserve their ordinary contracts
RxLogicalArguments only concatenates the adapter-prepared whole left and right elements; it performs neither group planning nor an additional opening pass

direct_producer_expression_contract.rule: Receiver contracts govern consumption; :: and modifiers always consume DATA. The grouper handles the supplied pure graph; ordinary named Structures with the current lexical parent follow the CODE call path, while foreign-parent named and anonymous Structures are grouped with their actual parents retained. The separate application adapter packages left as one actual and current-level right results as references. VALUE/TYPE/DATA stay in those roles; no source-origin flag, second opening pass or local :: evaluator is introduced.

builtin_mode_metadata: No PASS_ARGS_AS_IS value is inferred for builtin ::; the general RAW operand contract is unchanged.
anonymous_structure_contract: Never call an anonymous Structure as a callable/new activation. It can execute in place in CODE/Expression under the ordinary rules; consuming the whole signature description as DATA does not invoke it.

expression_architecture.grouper: Resolve priorities, groups and explicit field streams in the supplied pure graph, including references consumed as CODE/Expression. Notation, source origin and parenthesis history are not semantic flags. Produce a structured current-level operation/stream plan without rewriting or reparsing text.
expression_architecture.application_adapter: Package the left side as one actual and the current-level right stream as an Array of references under the receiving ABI. This packaging belongs to the application adapter, not the grouper.
expression_architecture.collector: RxLogicalArguments and library asOperand forward the projected actual vector; no element traversal, reverse packing or additional opening pass.
expression_architecture.roles: VALUE/TYPE/DATA and whole-value contracts do not become CODE automatically. In CODE/Expression, an ordinary named Structure with the current lexical parent follows the ordinary call path; a named Structure with a different parent and every anonymous Structure are handled as graph groups, retaining their real parent. Name/actual-parent relative to traversal owner determines the branch, not reference provenance. Planning does not run DATA or force RAW.
expression_architecture.raw_occurrence: Retain each complete nested Expression as one original RAW occurrence with its live context; do not pass its physical tokens as several actuals or evaluate it during planning.
expression_architecture.graph_references: Consume the supplied pure graph under its receiving role. In CODE/Expression: named + current lexical parent means ordinary call; named + other parent means group; anonymous means group. Preserve actual parent and binding context; do not use source-origin or parenthesis flags.

group_copy_equivalence.reason: copy is an explicit field stream; the current-level group assignment consumes that stream without an otherwise unnecessary outer RHS group. Values are ready before any destination write.
group_copy_equivalence.whole_value_control: scalar := (copy(d)) retains its Structure when scalar receives one whole value

parent_cases.expected: Treat S as the same group shape as direct (a b c d), preserving its actual parent and context; this branch creates no call activation.
Use the ordinary named-Structure call path and its admission; do not silently inline it as a foreign-parent group.

parent_cases.actual_parent: current lexical parent or another parent
parent_cases.expected: An anonymous Structure remains a group; execution, when required by CODE/Expression, is in place rather than a named call.

code_graph_reference_control.numeric_result: Not asserted: four neighboring atoms do not automatically form a numeric expression; + admission and any ordinary call result are checked separately.
code_graph_reference_control.value_boundary: A Structure admitted in a VALUE/TYPE/DATA position remains under that contract, regardless of its name or parent; the CODE classification is not applied automatically there.
code_graph_reference_control.provenance: Source spelling/origin and P0 diagnostic provenance do not decide the branch.
